_note: Draft for the maintainer, in the shape of the Space's data/methodology.json entrants.entrants records. Values are what this run loaded.
name: JEV-9B
served_params_detail: 7,936,684,544 Qwen3.5-9B text-backbone parameters (loaded as Qwen3_5ForCausalLM; the vision tower, the MTP layers and the 1,017,118,720-parameter lm_head are not loaded) plus the 98,328-parameter fp32 decision head. The rank-16 LoRA (40,108,032 parameters) is merged into the backbone in memory at load time, so it adds none at serve time.
readout: One prefill pass per question over the model's bare-v1 template ([kind]/[state]/[question]/[options] with A-P option letters, ending '[decision]:'); the final-norm hidden state of the last token goes through a linear fp32 head H -> 24 slots (noul 0-1, score 2-7, choice 8-23), inactive slots masked, divided by the per-kind temperature from calibration.json (noul 1.0022, choice 0.9840), softmax. No generation, no abstention outcome.

declared_capacity.over_16_options: ceil(n/16) contiguous groups of <= 16 read whole, then a final of 16 (each group's top option, free places by in-group probability); finalists keep the final's distribution times P(answer among finalists), others get their group's final share times their in-group probability. Every option is read; none is pruned.

training_data: SargeDev/jev-distill-corpus-v3 only (yuri_v3: TypeSafe Jev 1.13 output distributions over synthetic operational scenarios; openjev_v2: Open-Jev synthetic game/workflow tasks; yuri_v1: memory-relevance pairs with placeholder [0.5, 0.5] labels). No suite data used for training, checkpoint selection or temperature fitting.
